newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Banco Totta seen priced at some 2,695 esc.
newsitem.headline: Banco Totta seen priced at some 2,695 esc.

text.p: Shares in Banco Totta & Acores (BTA) were expected to be priced at 2,690-2,700 escudos at the closing session of its privatisation on the Lisbon bourse on Tuesday, traders and analysts said.
The government is offering its 13.22 percent stake in the bank, equal to 8.53 million shares, with most of the stock being sold directly to institutional investors in Portugal and abroad.

The bourse session to fix the price and distribution of the 1.6 million shares being offered to employees, small investors and the general public, on which the direct sale price will also be based, is set for 0930 GMT.
"Judging by the stock market trend, the price should be between 2,690 and 2,700 escudos," said one analyst who asked not to be named.
Over 152,000 shares were traded in Banco Totta on Monday as the price slipped 13 escudos to 2,707 escudos.
